signals.name: retainedBytes
signals.quantity: decompressed bytes of blocks whose CRC check passed; Bzip2Decoder#decode keeps these in the out list within one decode() call
signals.storage: static long fields retainedBytes/validBlocks/currentBlockBytes in fuzzing.v1.V1Counters, updated by V1Transformer-inserted calls
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() calls V1Counters.reset() before each execution

signals.name: decodedBytes
signals.quantity: number of decoded bytes (return value >= 0) produced by Bzip2BlockDecompressor#read(), i.e. writeByte calls on the output buffer

signals.name: bwtBytes
signals.quantity: sum of BWT block lengths returned by Bzip2BlockDecompressor#blockLength() (blocks that reached DECODE_HUFFMAN_DATA), plus the blocksReached count

plans.retention: Keep the input if it sets a new maximum retainedBytes or retainedBytes per input byte. Otherwise keep it if it reaches a new (blocksReached, validBlocks) pair or a new maximum decodedBytes/bwtBytes. While all signals are 0, keep inputs that set a new maximum length (growing toward input_bytes = 750) or that first reach blocksReached > 0. Parents are chosen in proportion to retainedBytes rank, with boosts for high validBlocks (kept blocks per decode() call, specific to the Bzip2Decoder INIT_BLOCK re-entry loop) and high measured output/input ratio.
mutation: genome (block-size digit + list of (byte, runLength) plaintext records) re-encoded with Netty's own io.netty.handler.codec.compression.Bzip2Encoder through an EmbeddedChannel, so block and stream CRCs are always valid
genome record mutations: change byte or run length (+-1, x2, /2, random), insert, delete, swap records, change the block-size digit
decoded-level repetition: repeat a slice of records k times, double the whole record list, multiply all run lengths
splice genomes of two corpus entries
byte-level on encoded bytes: bit and byte flips, random insertions and deletions
byte-level repetition: repeat a random chunk k times up to jqf.ei.MAX_INPUT_SIZE, including doubling the whole input
dictionary tokens from Bzip2Decoder/Bzip2Constants inserted or overwritten: 'BZh' (MAGIC_NUMBER), block-size digits '1'-'9', block magic 0x314159 0x265359, end-of-stream magic 0x177245 0x385090
